title: The public root is confirmed current by a full census, then its open conflicts and gaps are worked against the fresh sources
goal: A census of the whole public root dated after 2026-10-20 is tagged; every _conflicts.md entry is closed by a source or carries a note dated 2026-10-21 or later saying what was checked and what would settle it; every _gaps.md entry is researched into the kb from official sources or carries such a note; no fact is deleted, a wrong one is reworded or superseded with its source
notes: Operator request 2026-10-20: plan census, conflict resolution and gap filling, order chosen by the planner; answers: start after the 2026-10-19 housekeeping batch (closed on main by 2026-10-20), the whole census epic EP-mkzkd7in first, all open gaps including those already tried, no spend gate beyond each sprint's start approval. Order and why: (1) EP-mkzkd7in's census tooling stories, since the census run depends on each; (2) the census ST-zpe7qxtv then its sample and tag ST-ywqj4gva, since the last full census is census-2026-09-26 and 2754 of 4508 live sources joined after it, and fresh sources settle conflicts and narrow gaps; (3) the four conflict stories, read against the fresh sources, so a census rewording is not undone; (4) the ten gap stories, each after the conflict story of its domains, since gap research reads the same articles and a settled conflict can answer a gap. Baseline on main 86d404d7f (2026-10-20): 116 open _conflicts.md entries and 440 open _gaps.md entries by kbfacts.ledger_entries with no closing note (Resolved, Reviewed, Superseded, Closed, Partly resolved, Mostly resolved, Narrowed); kbmon's kb panel prints 440 gaps and 180 conflicts, its conflict count including closed ones (BG-sbxvmwmz). Batches split the entries by their first linked topic; each story's check lists the lines still unworked. The census phase 2 dispatch refuses inside .claude/worktrees, so the two census stories run from the main checkout through /kb-census, not as headless sprint workers. Stories touch disjoint article directories but share the ledgers, _sources.csv, _anchors.csv and _answers.md; parallel landings rebase on those.
